title: ChantPhrase
description: A recognized incantation phrase (V4). The voice service does VAD + local recognition + phrase alignment; Unreal's spell state machine never sees raw audio.

timestamp.description: LSL clock seconds at phrase end.

spell.description: Spell id from the chant grammar, e.g. FIRE_LANCE.

text.description: Recognized text (for logging only; never drives logic).

timing_error_ms.description: Deviation from the expected cadence for this phrase.
